tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs | 5+ yrs e-commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise-grade SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, microservices and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning and techno-functional consulting with international stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, fluent in English, based in Karlsruhe and strong teamwork.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders) (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join adesso SE because of its reputation for delivering innovative SAP Commerce solutions to leading enterprises. With over five years of hands-on experience building and extending SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately contribute to your projects.

bullets.label: Platform Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring and Spring Boot, covering product, catalog and pricing modules.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services and built robust PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) to synchronize product data across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: DevOps & Performance
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), leveraged Docker/Kubernetes and optimized SQL queries, improving system stability and response times.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to adesso SE.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders) (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die innovative Arbeit von adesso SE im Bereich SAP Commerce begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Erweiterung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Know-how mit, um Ihre Projekte sofort voranzutreiben.

bullets.label: Plattform-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte Backend- und Frontend-Funktionen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java, Spring und Spring Boot, inkl. Produkt- und Preis-Management.

bullets.label: API- und Integration
bullets.text: Erstellte OCC-REST-Webservices und robuste PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) zur Synchronisation von Produktdaten mit ERP- und MDM-Systemen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit internationalen Fachbereichen zusammen, analysierte Anforderungen, schrieb User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzte sie in skalierbare SAP-Commerce-Lösungen um.

bullets.label: DevOps & Performance
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments über das SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) durch, nutzte Docker/Kubernetes und optimierte SQL-Abfragen, wodurch Stabilität und Antwortzeiten verbessert wurden.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag für adesso SE zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: adesso SE stands out as a leading digital transformation partner that combines deep SAP expertise with a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Your focus on delivering end-to-end SAP Commerce solutions for diverse industries aligns perfectly with my background in building scalable Hybris platforms for global manufacturers. I am eager to contribute to your high-impact projects and grow within a team that values cutting-edge technology and collaborative problem-solving.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate SAP Commerce specialist with 5+ years of Hybris experience, ready to drive innovative e-commerce solutions at adesso SE.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the SAP Commerce Developer role at adesso SE and would love to discuss how I can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position at adesso SE. With over five years of experience delivering robust SAP Commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute immediately. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application.
